name: 14462-longdecode-dsv2lite-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2), SM90, NVLink within the node. One node, one allocation.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=400, bounded at 2400 requests with a 5400 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion (1800 requests scored).
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 512 tokens and output EXACTLY 2048 (min = max on both), so every request is the same shape; `ignore_eos=True` is forced whenever max_tokens is set, so all 2048 tokens are always generated. The prompt is sent as plain text with no chat template, and the engine reports its own token count.
purpose: A code-generation assistant producing long 2048-token completions from short prompts for 400 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit ef640440791a461a181e6d497965701462c166b3 (`v0.7.3-305-gef64044079`).
# CAUTION, flat reader: a line that starts with a space is skipped, so every key must be
# top-level and every value must fit on one line.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct

# Required, not decorative: `deepseek_v2` is not a model_type the pinned transformers
# knows, so AutoConfig cannot load this repo's config without it.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 2
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096

# 0.42 is a declared value of this setup, not a leftover or the engine default. Do not
# raise it.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.42

max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
